# Implementation Checklist Template

## Planning
- [ ] Module spec completed and reviewed
- [ ] Scope boundaries documented
- [ ] Acceptance criteria approved

## Design
- [ ] Navigation and layout states defined
- [ ] Empty/loading/error states defined
- [ ] Accessibility checks planned

## Data and Contracts
- [ ] Domain entities confirmed
- [ ] API/event contracts drafted
- [ ] Validation and permissions mapped

## Engineering
- [ ] Tasks broken down by milestone
- [ ] Test strategy defined
- [ ] Logging/monitoring requirements captured

## Release Readiness
- [ ] QA/UAT scenarios listed
- [ ] Rollout plan documented
- [ ] Post-release metrics and owners assigned
